cards.example_en: Power cuts are a rare occurrence in our village.
cards.example_zh: 我们村很少停电。
cards.explain_zh: 事件义可数；发生义不可数；注意双写rr。

cards.example_en: Power cuts are a rare occurrence in our village.
cards.example_zh: 我们村很少停电。

cards.example_en: The mother duck led her offspring safely across the path.
cards.example_zh: 鸭妈妈带着小鸭们安全地穿过小路。
cards.explain_zh: 单复数同形；谈人的子女时比children正式。

cards.example_en: The sudden onset of rain sent us running indoors.
cards.example_zh: 突然下起雨来，我们赶紧跑进屋里。
cards.explain_zh: 常用the onset of，多指疾病或不利情况的开始。

cards.example_en: The sudden onset of rain sent us running indoors.
cards.example_zh: 突然下起雨来，我们赶紧跑进屋里。

cards.example_en: From September onwards, the library will open on Sundays.
cards.example_zh: 从九月起，图书馆将于星期日开放。

cards.example_en: This optical illusion makes the flat drawing look three-dimensional.
cards.example_zh: 这种视错觉让平面的图画看起来像立体的。
cards.explain_zh: optical涉及光或视觉；optical illusion指视错觉。

cards.example_en: This optical illusion makes the flat drawing look three-dimensional.
cards.example_zh: 这种视错觉让平面的图画看起来像立体的。

cards.example_en: This sunny windowsill provides optimal conditions for my herbs.
cards.example_zh: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我的香草提供了最适宜的生长条件。
cards.explain_zh: 已含“最佳”之意，通常不再用 most 修饰。

cards.example_en: This sunny windowsill provides optimum conditions for my herbs.
cards.example_zh: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我种的香草提供了最适宜的条件。
cards.explain_zh: 强调最适合目标，并非越多越好；通常不用most修饰。

cards.example_en: This sunny windowsill provides optimum conditions for my herbs.
cards.example_zh: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我种的香草提供了最适宜的条件。

cards.example_en: Our teacher gave us oral feedback after each presentation.
cards.example_zh: 每次展示后，老师都会给我们口头反馈。
cards.explain_zh: oral既指口头的，也指口腔的；oral medication是口服药。

cards.example_en: The heart is an organ that pumps blood.
cards.example_zh: 心脏是输送血液的器官。
cards.explain_zh: organ指器官；organism指完整的生物体。

cards.example_en: Public awareness campaigns can encourage organ donation and help reduce waiting times for patients needing transplants.
cards.example_zh: 公众宣传活动能够鼓励器官捐献，帮助缩短需要移植的患者的等待时间。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The scientists discovered a tiny organism living near the hot spring.
cards.example_zh: 科学家在温泉附近发现了一种微小生物。

cards.example_en: A campus map helps new students orient themselves.
cards.example_zh: 校园地图帮助新生熟悉方位。

cards.example_en: During orientation, a student guide showed us the library.
cards.example_zh: 入学指导期间，一位学生向导带我们参观了图书馆。
cards.explain_zh: 入学指导常用orientation；方位义常用于建筑。

cards.example_en: A comprehensive orientation programme can help international students understand academic expectations and access essential support services.
cards.example_zh: 全面的入学指导计划能帮助国际学生了解学业要求，并获得必要的支持服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We watched the slow oscillation of the clock's pendulum.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着钟摆缓缓地来回摆动。
cards.explain_zh: 既指物体往复运动，也指数值或观点的反复变化。

cards.example_en: A radial road network connects outer residential districts directly to the city centre.
cards.example_zh: 放射状道路网将外围住宅区直接连接到市中心。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: A new clothing outlet opened near the station yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天车站附近新开了一家服装店。
cards.explain_zh: outlet for常指表达渠道；美式英语中也指电源插座。

cards.example_en: A flock of geese flew overhead as we walked home.
cards.example_zh: 我们步行回家时，一群雁从头顶飞过。
cards.explain_zh: 名词重音在首音节；运营开支英式常用overheads。

cards.example_en: Small businesses can reduce overhead costs by sharing office space and using energy more efficiently.
cards.example_zh: 小企业可以通过共享办公空间和提高能源使用效率来降低运营开支。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The curtains overlap slightly in the middle of the window.
cards.example_zh: 窗帘在窗户中间略有重叠。
cards.explain_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；过去式overlapped。

cards.example_en: Our guide gave us an overview of the tour.
cards.example_zh: 导游向我们简要介绍了游览安排。
cards.explain_zh: 通常作可数名词；搭配an overview of。

cards.example_en: Our guide gave us an overview of the tour.
cards.example_zh: 导游向我们简要介绍了游览安排。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The cut apple began to oxidize and turn brown.
cards.example_zh: 切开的苹果开始氧化，变成了褐色。
cards.explain_zh: 英式也拼作oxidise；氧化不一定涉及氧气。

cards.example_en: The nurse gave him oxygen through a clear plastic mask.
cards.example_zh: 护士通过透明塑料面罩给他输氧。
cards.explain_zh: oxygen是不可数名词，不说an oxygen。

cards.example_en: Pollution can reduce oxygen levels in rivers, making it difficult for fish and other aquatic organisms to survive.
cards.example_zh: 污染会降低河流中的含氧量，使鱼类和其他水生生物难以生存。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My ankle is still painful when I climb stairs.
cards.example_zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是很疼。
cards.explain_zh: painful可指身体疼痛，也可指情感痛苦或难堪。

cards.example_en: For many workers, losing a secure job is a painful experience that affects both confidence and financial stability.
cards.example_zh: 对许多劳动者而言，失去稳定工作是一段痛苦的经历，既影响信心，也影响经济稳定。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I'm feeling below par, so I'll stay home tonight.
cards.example_zh: 我感觉状态不佳，所以今晚会待在家里。
cards.explain_zh: on a par with表示不相上下；below par指状态欠佳。

cards.example_en: I'm feeling below par, so I'll stay home tonight.
cards.example_zh: 我感觉状态不佳，所以今晚会待在家里。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The theory introduced a new paradigm for studying language learning.
cards.example_zh: 这一理论为研究语言学习引入了新的范式。

cards.example_en: It seems a paradox that resting helps me accomplish more.
cards.example_zh: 休息反而能让我完成更多事情，这似乎很矛盾。
cards.explain_zh: 强调看似矛盾却可能成立，不等于普通错误。

cards.example_en: You can adjust this parameter to sharpen the image.
cards.example_zh: 你可以调整这个参数，让图像更清晰。
cards.explain_zh: 表限定条件时常用复数；勿与周长perimeter混淆。

cards.example_en: A small parcel arrived for you this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上有个寄给你的小包裹到了。
cards.explain_zh: 包裹在英式英语中常用parcel，美式英语更常用package。

cards.example_en: Pardon? I couldn't hear you over the washing machine.
cards.example_zh: 请再说一遍？洗衣机太吵，我没听清。
cards.explain_zh: 没听清时可说Pardon?，语调通常上扬。

cards.example_en: Paid parental leave allows new parents to care for their children without immediately returning to work.
cards.example_zh: 带薪育儿假让新手父母能够照顾孩子，而不必立即重返工作岗位。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The date appears in parenthesis after the title.
cards.example_zh: 日期出现在标题后的圆括号中。

cards.example_en: The survey provides only a partial picture of local employment.
cards.example_zh: 这项调查只能部分反映当地的就业状况。

cards.example_en: The curtains were partially open, letting in sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 窗帘开了一部分，让阳光透了进来。
cards.explain_zh: partially表示不完全地；不要误解为偏心地。

cards.example_en: The curtains were partially open, letting in sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 窗帘开了一部分，让阳光透了进来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A tiny particle of dust was visible under the microscope.
cards.example_zh: 显微镜下可以看到一粒微小的灰尘。

cards.example_en: A wooden partition separates our kitchen from the dining area.
cards.example_zh: 一道木隔板将我们的厨房与用餐区隔开。
cards.explain_zh: partition off指隔出空间，如隔出一间办公室。

cards.example_en: Schools should let students explore different subjects before requiring them to choose a specialist pathway.
cards.example_zh: 学校应让学生先探索不同学科，再要求他们选择专业方向。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The painting shows a peasant carrying vegetables home.
cards.example_zh: 这幅画描绘了一位背着蔬菜回家的农民。
cards.explain_zh: 多用于历史或传统农业语境；称呼他人可能带贬义。

cards.example_en: The old boiler needs periodic checks to keep working safely.
cards.example_zh: 这台旧锅炉需要定期检查，才能继续安全运行。
cards.explain_zh: periodic是形容词，不是名词；副词为periodically。

cards.example_en: The old boiler needs periodic checks to keep working safely.
cards.example_zh: 这台旧锅炉需要定期检查，才能继续安全运行。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Regular physical activity may delay the onset of certain chronic diseases and improve overall wellbeing.
word.example_zh: 经常进行体育活动可能延缓某些慢性病的发生，并改善整体健康状况。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
